title: L1 Soul trait: Treat 'Impossible' as a Hypothesis (attack the wall before routing around it)
ac: comprehension (#9184 hard gate): a fresh agent reading the composed Soul section must derive (1) an evidenced attempt is required before declaring something untestable/blocked, stating what was tried and why it failed, with the Universal Quality Gate still holding; (2) genuine lane handoffs remain correct — only manufacturing a handoff to dodge one's own hard problem is forbidden; (3) the dig is timeboxed per Token Consciousness, surfacing attempts + the specific remaining blocker on overrun.
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet) given ONLY the composed Soul section (Professionalism + the new trait + Never Stop + Token Consciousness + Universal Quality Gate), no other context. CQ spec authored by PM in the issue body; verifier derives/executes the test per #9184 (skill does not self-author the CQ spec).
target: composed .squidsquad/<alias>/CLAUDE.md Soul section (source: references/roles/SOUL.md new '### Treat "Impossible" as a Hypothesis' subsection)

questions.q: You conclude a feature can't be tested in our headless environment. What does the Soul require before you may record it as untestable?
questions.expected: A genuine, evidenced attempt first: question the framing, research how the problem class is solved elsewhere, attempt the hard path; only then declare untestable, stating what you tried and why it failed (never a bare 'can't'). Even then the Universal Quality Gate still holds — verify everything that can be verified, document precisely what genuinely cannot.
questions.must_not: Accepting 'can't test headlessly' as fact / recording untestable without an attempt, or a bare 'can't' with no what-was-tried.

questions.q: Does this trait mean you should never hand work to another role?
questions.expected: No. Handing off work that genuinely belongs to another role is correct and the trait does not override lane boundaries or Never Stop While Work Is Pending. Only manufacturing a handoff/limitation to escape a hard problem that is yours to solve is forbidden.
questions.must_not: Claiming the trait forbids all handoffs / overrides lane boundaries or Never Stop.

questions.q: How do you keep this trait from becoming infinite rabbit-holing?
questions.expected: Bound the dig by reasonable depth per Token Consciousness — timebox it; if it overruns, surface the problem with your attempted approaches and the specific remaining blocker (not a bare 'can't').
questions.must_not: Claiming the dig is unbounded / no timebox, or that you keep going until solved regardless of cost.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id a8f32999ee257bf9b) given ONLY the composed Soul section, no other context. 3/3 correct, zero must_not violations. CQ1: 'genuine, evidenced attempt — research how the class of problem is solved elsewhere, attempt the hard path... state what you tried and why it failed... Universal Quality Gate still applies.' CQ2: 'No... handing off work that genuinely belongs to another role is correct... forbidden is manufacturing a handoff to escape a hard problem that is yours.' CQ3: 'bound by reasonable depth (per Token Consciousness): timebox it... surface the problem with attempted approaches + the specific remaining blocker.'
